lastUpdated.patchNote: Changed by [Chaos: A Realm Divided] Season Announcement (2026-06-25). Base Block 750→950, Block recovery 27→47; "Run 'Em Through" invincibility 1s→1.6s but max stab hits reduced 3→2 (target limit for 2nd hit +1); basic attacks vs blocking units no longer trigger weapon-bounce Dazed

battleRole.role: Mobile shielded melee, trades some defense for speed

steps.text: Press 1: dashes forward twice (occasionally three times) dealing big damage; the unit is fully invincible during the dash. Press 2: a small shieldbash — okay-ish damage, good block/counter. Timing on press 1 is everything; no simple rule, learned per matchup. Rarely, pressing 2 before 1 can change the matchup entirely.
Huge block and defense make the unit fairly tanky — retreat after one dash-forward with spell 1 to preserve the unit rather than pushing deeper into a bad trade.
